name: Hogenakkal Riverside Fish Fry Stalls
area: Cauvery river bank, below the falls
signature_dish: Fresh Cauvery river fish fried in Tamil masala over a wood fire
must_try: fried fish with rice and sambar
why_it_matters: Hogenakkal's defining food experience is the riverside fish fry — fish caught daily from the Kaveri (katla, rohu, kendai, valai, mirgal and more) is displayed in baskets on the sandy shore, cleaned and scaled in front of you, then fried over wood fires in a traditional Tamil masala at improvised riverside kitchens. There are no formal restaurants here; this is the reason people come to eat at Hogenakkal.
insider_tip: Pick your fish from the basket, agree the price before it is cooked (typically ₹150-300 for the frying depending on fish and quantity), and have it with rice and sambar. Freshest in the late morning after the day's catch. Carry small cash.
signature_address: Cauvery river bank, below Hogenakkal Falls, Hogenakkal, Dharmapuri District, Tamil Nadu 636810

name: Amudham Restaurant (TTDC Hotel Tamil Nadu)
signature_dish: South Indian veg meals and fish fry near the falls
why_it_matters: The Amudham restaurant at TTDC's Hotel Tamil Nadu — the most reliable sit-down eatery in Hogenakkal, about 120m from the falls and the hanging bridge. With a minimal menu but good quality at low prices (breakfast around ₹130, lunch veg meals around ₹168 with fish fry and chicken available), it is the proper-meal alternative to the riverside fish stalls.
insider_tip: The dependable option if you want a clean sit-down meal rather than the riverside stalls — breakfast and the veg lunch meal are good value, with fish fry and chicken as add-ons. Closest formal dining to the falls. Cash; UPI may work.
signature_address: TTDC Hotel Tamil Nadu, near Hogenakkal Falls, Hogenakkal, Dharmapuri District, Tamil Nadu 636810

name: Hogenakkal Tender Coconut and Snack Stalls
area: Falls approach road and main parking
signature_dish: Tender coconut water and quick snacks at the falls entrance
why_it_matters: Lining the falls approach road and main parking area, the tender-coconut and snack stalls are the everyday quick-bite of Hogenakkal — cold coconut water, bajji, tea and fruit for visitors before or after the coracle rides. With no formal restaurants in town, these stalls plus the fish fry are the realistic food picture.
insider_tip: A tender coconut is the right move in Hogenakkal's heat after a coracle ride. Stalls cluster at the parking and approach road. Small cash only.
signature_address: Falls approach road and main parking, Hogenakkal, Dharmapuri District, Tamil Nadu 636810
